Maria G: Quick update — PrismAnalytics interview finished this morning. We have raw audio + transcript and a first-pass case study draft. Need legal sign-off on the three pull quotes and approval to use Prism logo on the site. Also want to sync on whether we announce alongside the upcoming benchmarking webinar next Tue. :tada:

Sam R: Great. Can you drop the draft + the specific quotes here? I'll coordinate the publication timeline with product marketing.

Maria G: Dropping the quotes here (pulled from transcript). These are the ones we want as highlight quotes:
```
"Redwood cut our inference cost by over 60% while improving 99th percentile latency" — Priya N, Head of ML, PrismAnalytics
"The Dedicated cluster made it so our throughput was predictable during peak reports" — Priya N
"We shipped a benchmarks-driven proof in 2 weeks that convinced the board" — CTO (Anand S)
```

Eli K: Priya already gave a quick verbal ok on the logo, but legal needs the release language. I'll ping the account and ask for written permission.

Tasha L: Please send the transcript and the exact, final pull-quote copy. I need to review for: 1) any regulatory or comparative claims ("60%" needs source/backing), 2) export/control language if they name models/hardware, 3) trademark use for Prism logo.

Maria G: Uploaded transcript and draft case study to the shared drive: https://redwood.example.com/drive/prism-cs-draft. The "60%" stat is from their internal cost analysis comparing baseline infra to Redwood batching + quantization. I added a parenthetical note with the benchmark methodology section.

Priya N: Hi team — I can confirm the 60% is their aggregated figure for our Q4 test. They asked to keep the per-model breakdown internal. Fine with quote as-is if we keep methodology note. Also ok with logo use.

Tasha L: Ok that's helpful. Two asks from Legal: please (A) add a short methodology blurb under the stat that we can link to (non-sensitive), and (B) get a signed permission email from Prism's legal or their C-level. Once I have those, I'll draft a one-paragraph release approval.

Nate D: Design can mock up the hero banner with Prism logo tomorrow. Do we want the banner to include the 60% stat visually?

Maria G: Yes — A/B test with and without stat for landing page. For social posts, we'll lead with the customer outcome and link to the case study.

Sam R: Webinar tie-in — product wants to reference the case study in the benchmarking webinar. Proposal: publish case study Thurs EOD, promote during webinar Tue, and have an in-webinar CTA to a short signup that routes inbound leads to Growth (that's us) + CS for trial offers. Thoughts?

Eli K: Routing plan: funnel leads from webinar signup into Pardot list "Prism-webinar-traffic", tag for "case-study-engaged" and then Sales queue. Sam, can you confirm SLA for contact? We usually reach out within 48 hours.

Sam R: 48h is fine. For high-fit accounts (company size > 500 and specific vertical tag), escalate within 6 hours to AE. We'll add a routing rule for that.

Priya N: From customer ops: Prism asked that we don't do a salesy follow-up until a week after the publish date; they'd prefer a "thank you" email with a short survey first. Can we honor that?

Eli K: We can delay outreach for general leads. For high-fit accounts, maybe a "trusted contact" note from their CSM only. I'll draft language.

Tasha L: Back to legal — once I have the signed permission and the methodology blurb, I'll give final sign-off. ETA: 48 hours after receipt of those items.

Maria G: Action items summary:
- Maria: finalize pull-quote copy + add methodology blurb in the draft (today)
- Eli: request signed permission from Prism legal and collect an approval email (today)
- Tasha: legal review once above received (48h)
- Nate: design hero + social assets (tomorrow)
- Sam: set up webinar CTA routing and Pardot list rules (today)
- Priya: confirm internal ok for quote and logo (done)

Sam R: I'll block time with Product PMs to confirm mention in slides. Also setting the Pardot routing now.

Eli K: Prism legal asked for a short approval template to sign. I'll post it here in a sec.

Maria G: Thanks all. If legal greenlights by Mon mid-day we can still hit Thur publish and tie into the webinar. If not, fallback publish to next Tue. :eyes:

Eli K: Permission email from Prism legal received — copying the signed note into the drive.

Tasha L: Received signed permission and methodology blurb. I'm doing final pass. Minor edit suggested on the CTO quote (remove "board"). Sending redline now.

Maria G: Redline looks fine. Approved to publish from Marketing side if Legal confirms.

Tasha L: Final legal sign-off provided. "PrismAnalytics case study — Redwood Inference" approved for publication and logo use. I'll attach the approval reference ID: LEG-2026-0421-PRISM.

Sam R: Publishing plan confirmed: case study goes live Thu EOD, webinar CTA configured to route leads as discussed. I'll send the promo calendar and short copy by EOD. :rocket:

Maria G: Amazing — thanks team. We'll coordinate the social + newsletter draft in another thread.

(automated) deploy-bot: Published assets staged for deployment — preview link: https://staging.redwood.example.com/case-studies/prismanalytics

Maria G: Preview looks good. Closing this thread — will post the final live link when up. :white_check_mark:
